facts.claim: 凯向马丁娜索要迪尔德丽·格雷戈里全部探视者的书面记录。
facts.quote: “I’ll need a written record of all Deirdre Gregory’s visitors,” said Kay.

facts.claim: 马丁娜压低声音建议他们去找「刚提过的那个男人」——奥斯汀·格雷戈里 whisperer 卢克·富尔顿。
facts.quote: You should talk to the guy I was just telling you about.

facts.claim: 三人被领进另一间压抑的会议室，卢克随即穿着与埃迪同款的灰色狱警制服出现。
facts.quote: We were ushered into another depressing conference room

facts.claim: 贝尔极轻地摇头示意，卢克立刻会意，装作不认识她。
facts.quote: He knew immediately to pretend as though he didn’t recognize me

facts.claim: 被问工作年限，卢克答「十七年」，并说自己是从清洁工做起、花两年才升为狱警。
卢克用斯坦福监狱实验解释自己与奥斯汀的相处之道。
facts.quote: “Ever heard of the Stanford Prison Experiment?” he asked finally.

facts.claim: 凯请求「远远看一眼」奥斯汀，卢克耸肩答应，带她们去后院。
后院里奥斯汀独自站着，突然转身直盯贝尔，她被那双黑洞般的眼睛看得倒吸一口气。
facts.quote: It was terrifying to have those black-hole eyes trained on me

relations.rel: 探员与监狱联络人：凯向她索取探视记录，她则要求走正式申请流程。
relations.quote: “Of course,” replied Martina. “You’ll have to submit a formal request

relations.rel: 同事：马丁娜称他为「奥斯汀 whisperer」，力荐凯去找他。
网上结识、互有好感的两人首次线下见面，全程以眼神默契互相掩护。
探员与受访狱警：凯主导问话，卢克简短作答。
relations.quote: “We hear you’re the Austin Gregory whisperer.”

relations.rel: 狱警与囚犯：相处十七年，卢克断言奥斯汀「从不说一个字」。
relations.quote: “He won’t say a word,” said Luke. “He never does.”

relations.rel: 隔院相望：奥斯汀的黑洞般目光直逼贝尔，令她当场失态。
relations.quote: he looked right at me. I’m ashamed to admit this, but I gasped.

numbers.claim: 贝尔原以为卢克在此工作十五年。
numbers.quote: I already knew the answer to this one: fifteen years.

numbers.claim: 卢克自报的实际工作年限。
从清洁工熬到狱警所用的时间。
numbers.quote: “Took two years to work my way up to guard.”

numbers.claim: 凯复述：卢克当狱警十五年，奥斯汀一直在押。
numbers.quote: Fifteen years as a guard, with Austin Gregory here that whole time

numbers.claim: 奥斯汀的外貌与二十年前几乎无异。
numbers.quote: looked remarkably the same as he had twenty years earlier

numbers.claim: 受害者吉纳维芙·斯普鲁斯当年十四岁。
numbers.quote: the size differential between him and the fourteen-year-old Genevieve Spruce

numbers.claim: 后院遮阳帆下聚集约二十四名囚犯。
numbers.quote: about two dozen men all dressed in khaki pants and short-sleeved shirts

numbers.claim: 卢克在他们落座后一两分钟出现。
numbers.quote: He appeared a minute or two later, wearing the same outfit as Eddie.

numbers.claim: 这间会议室只有前一间的一半大。
numbers.quote: except this one was half the size, and smelled musty in addition to stuffy

numbers.claim: 凯预计申请会见奥斯汀的法院文件要数周。
numbers.quote: I’m sure it’ll take a few weeks.

numbers.claim: 凯大学修过心理学入门课，故称听过该实验。
numbers.quote: “Sure, I’ve heard of it,” Kay said genially. “I took Psych 101 in college.”

numbers.claim: 奥斯汀二十岁时胡子还没这么长这么密。
numbers.quote: Perhaps his beard hadn’t been so long and full at twenty years old

numbers.claim: 迪尔德丽·格雷戈里昨天刚从死马监狱释放。
numbers.quote: the death of Deirdre Gregory, who was released here yesterday

turning_point: 贝尔最怕被卢克当场认出，却被他默契掩护；卢克答应带她们远观奥斯汀，而奥斯汀突然转身用黑洞般的目光直逼贝尔，让她当场失态。
notes: 本章无明确日期；卢克工作年限与贝尔记忆不符（她记十五年，他说十七年）属人物信息差，非文本错误；「Austin Whisperer」原文如此。
